content_sections.text: Register details in the Google Form given through the QR code in the notice; this is compulsory. Download the application form from https://madurai.nic.in/notice_category/recruitment/. Attach self-attested copies of all certificates relevant to the post. Submit the original application form in person or by post at the District Health Office, Madurai. Applications must reach by 5 PM on 04.12.2026; later applications will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of District Health Society - Madurai, dated 20 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHS Madurai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DHS Madurai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 62 vacancies for Contractual / Temporary Staff Nurse.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DHS Madurai Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Application form on pages 3-4 of the notice; also downloadable from https://madurai.nic.in/notice_category/recruitment/) and send it to District Health Officer / Executive Secretary, District Health Society, District Health Office, Viswanathapuram, Madurai - 625 014, by in person or by post, to reach by 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 50 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No salary amount is mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Diploma in Nursing (GNM) or B.Sc. Nursing from a Government or Government-recognised private nursing college recognised by the Indian Nursing Council; Tamil Nadu Nursing Council registration compulsory.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Registration in Tamil Nadu Nursing Council is compulsory. A voluntary consent letter (Undertaking) for joining the post must be given.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Posts are purely temporary, on contract basis as per National Health Mission rules. Service will not be regularised at any time.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: CEmONC centres (including SNCU and PICU) under Madurai District Health Society.

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Birth certificate; Mark sheets (S.S.L.C, +2, Diploma, Degree); Transfer Certificate; Community Certificate; Residence certificate; Special category certificate (Transgender / Differently abled / Destitute Women or Widow / Ex-Service Man / vulnerability decided by Chairman, District Health Society).
